body:
Released in [`@emseepea/testing` 0.22.0](https://github.com/emseepea/emseepea/releases/tag/%40emseepea%2Ftesting%400.22.0). Following Tom Howard’s explicit decision to remove the limit, native Claude and Codex conversations no longer reject more than three advertised MCP calls. There is no replacement count ceiling or maxToolCalls option. Claude provider rounds are validated independently of parallel call counts; its existing four-round execution allowance remains.

Advertised-tool restrictions, existing execution limits, isolation, and application assertions remain enforced. Parser checks retain all forty calls and their results and hashed evidence. The real native timetable qualification requires four authoritative MCP reads and correct route-to-time associations in every trial. Existing independent meaning judgments remain required; failed semantic trials were not retried.

Exact-source qualification, Source Quality, Release, and Publish passed. Testing 0.22.0 and all eleven initializer updates are verified on npm latest; the testing guide is deployed. ADR-0116 records the approved replacement for the original configurable-budget proposal. This release removes the count-exhaustion failure; it does not claim new transcripts for unrelated provider failures.
